build: cargo build --release -p casars-simulation --bin simobserve; macOS arm64, Rust 1.99.0, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, own worktree target; task default backend/worker settings
command: CASAPY tools/simulation/simobserve_parity.py --out OUT --casars-bin TARGET/release/simobserve --casatestdata PUBLIC_LOCAL_COPY --only model_direction model_cell model_direction_cell components_cube frame_topo coarse_cell schedule_hour_number schedule_hour_quantity schedule_refdate_modern schedule_square frame_lsrd frame_geo frame_galacto frame_lgroup frame_cmb pointing_file_multiple pointing_explicit_spacing

source_audit.method: Full tracked-source archive with refreshed mtimes, then comparison of every tracked file SHA-256 against the local commit. An older scratch copy predated a main merge; the original historical receipts retain those earlier source pins, and this new source/binary was rebuilt for this replay.

inputs: Original public casatestdata core5ps.skymodel, core5ps.clist and flatone.model; committed multiple-pointing file; installed ALMA alma.out01.cfg. Both CASA and native sides rerun together.

comparison.timing: Compare equal stored TIME using the approved TAI-labelled-UTC alignment.
comparison.other: Unchanged compare_sm_ms.py checks MS descriptors, keywords, subtables, row/cell values, flags and existing documented differences. Model pixels/coordinates, exact non-graphics product names and byte-identical pointing files are checked. Spectral reference code agrees and frequencies use absolute tolerance 1e-3 Hz. Only coarse_cell is an expected matched refusal; all other cases must succeed.

validation.targeted_crates: simobserve, simutil_casa, readantenna_casa, skymodel_casa and the simulation task pass after complete source synchronization

limits: These are bounded correctness comparisons for the 17 named scenarios, not exhaustive combinations, graphics, noise, performance or whole-programme memory acceptance. Release timings are run diagnostics, with no performance claim. The plan goal of 1 micrometre UVW is stricter than the retained 1 millimetre oracle gate; the largest measured difference is reported without relaxing either requirement.
